author: Dutta, D. and others
title: Search for $B_{s}^{0} \to \gamma \gamma$ and a Measurement of the Branching Fraction for $B_{s}^{0} \to \phi \gamma$
abstract: We search for the decay $B_{s}^{0} \to \gamma \gamma$ and measure the branching fraction for $B_{s}^{0} \to \phi \gamma$ using 121.4 fb$^{-1}$ of data collected at the $\Upsilon(5S)$ resonance with the Belle detector at the KEKB asymmetric-energy $e^{+} e^{-}$ collider. We find no statistically significant evidence for the $B_{s}^{0} \to \gamma \gamma$ signal and set an upper limit on its branching fraction at $3.1 \times 10^{-6}$. We measure the branching fraction for $B_{s}^{0} \to \phi \gamma$ to be $(3.6 \pm 0.5 \pm 0.3 \pm 0.6) \times 10^{-5}$.
